title: Delhi sets up DITI on lines of NITI Aayog, to act as premier advisory body
description:
Delhi government has set up Delhi Institute for Transformation and Innovation (DITI) on the lines of NITI Aayog, for policy-making under its goal of "Viksit Dilli by 2047", officials said on Saturday.
DITI will function as the Delhi government's premier advisory body for public policy, development strategy and institutional reforms, an official notification said.
DITI replaces the Dialogue and Development Commission (DDC) that previously served as the think tank of the city government under AAP rule.
Chief Minister Rekha Gupta had announced the constitution of DITI  in Delhi's budget presented in March. In July, the Delhi government approved setting up the think tank comprising a Governing Board and an Executive Committee.
According to the notification, the governing board's chairperson will be nominated by the chief minister.
